tasks.short: Plan, provide and evaluate nursing, team or community educational programs.

steps.what: Assess actual audience needs and choose nursing or community education objectives
inputs: actual staff, team or community learning needs
current checked professional education sources

steps.what: Plan educational programs by assembling selected current explanations, diagrams and exercises
inputs: chosen audience-specific objectives and sources
actual current reusable teaching sections

steps.what: Check the whole program for accuracy, accessibility and audience suitability
inputs: complete audience-specific education program draft
chosen audience-specific objectives and sources

steps.what: Provide the actual educational program and respond to real participant questions
inputs: checked saved final education program
actual participating staff, team or community members
outputs: actual program delivery and participant responses

steps.what: Evaluate the actual educational program against observed learning and feedback
inputs: actual program delivery and participant responses
actual collected feedback and learning checks
outputs: actual program evaluation and necessary changes

steps.what: Write and check actual education outcomes and assigned follow-up in the program record
inputs: actual program evaluation and necessary changes
outputs: checked saved actual education evaluation record

tasks.design: Configure reuse of selected current teaching sections in {DOCS}/{LMS}. Retain audience assessment, substantive adaptation, complete final checks, actual teaching, learning evaluation and fresh outcome recording after delivery.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stable teaching diagrams and explanations can be assembled repeatedly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native section reuse removes assembly while preserving deliberate content selection.
tasks.still_hard: Actual participant understanding and appropriate clinical explanations require professional judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The midwife recognizes a misunderstanding that the prepared material did not address.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: selected current teaching-section reuse can reduce educational program preparation.

assumptions: Provisional preparation25 removes six repeated section/diagram assembly points, retaining19 adaptation points and full final checks10. Source owner supplies actual section revision, source and intended audience; midwife checks current applicability and prepares missing content manually. Existing reuse receives zero credit.

Actual learner observations and feedback are captured during delivery35 and evaluation10, not assumed to exist before the event. Record5 includes real assigned writing/checking and ordinary ungated saving with no saving. Drop/reweight records if not actually owned. No publication, certificate, patient instruction send or separate self-approval is invented.
unknowns: Which current sections can actually be reused for this audience?
research_questions: Does reuse retain clinical qualifications and accessibility appropriate to the actual audience?

incremental.description: Maintain current teaching-section sources and intended audiences.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes6 repeated assembly points minus0.6 upkeep=5.4. Low: a new community audience needs fresh explanations and exercises, leaving only2 familiar diagram assembly points removable, minus0.6=1.4. Audience choices, adaptation, full checks, teaching and actual evaluation records remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Conduct clinical research on maternal, infant and gynecological health topics.

steps.what: Define the actual clinical research question, protocol and permitted data scope
inputs: actual maternal, infant, contraceptive, breastfeeding or gynecological research question
actual authorized protocol and data-use conditions
outputs: checked study definitions and permitted data fields

steps.what: Collect actual permitted clinical observations and verify and capture research data
inputs: checked study definitions and permitted data fields
actual permitted observations and existing clinical records
outputs: checked actual source observations with permitted study ids and provenance

steps.what: Transfer already verified permitted research fields into the separate study dataset
inputs: checked actual source observations with permitted study ids and provenance
checked study definitions and permitted data fields
outputs: mapped study dataset with source provenance and explicit mapping exceptions

steps.what: Validate the actual study dataset and analyze and interpret clinical research findings
inputs: mapped study dataset with source provenance and explicit mapping exceptions
checked study definitions and permitted data fields
outputs: validated actual analysis and qualified clinical research findings

steps.what: Write and check the actual clinical research account and retain its internal record
inputs: validated actual analysis and qualified clinical research findings
checked study definitions and permitted data fields
outputs: checked saved clinical research account with limitations

tasks.design: Map already verified permitted fields from the actual clinical research capture application, OTHER, into the separate study dataset in {DATA_PLATFORM}. Keep protocol decisions, actual observation and capture, dataset validation, scientific interpretation and complete written findings; ordinary internal saves remain ungated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Verified research observations can be re-keyed into a separate analysis dataset.
tasks.enabler_now: Deterministic versioned field mapping can remove that second-system transfer.
tasks.still_hard: Eligibility, measurement quality, confounding and clinical interpretation need actual scientific judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The midwife recognizes that observed feeding or maternal outcomes are not causally comparable.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: deterministic mappings can transfer verified permitted research fields between distinct datasets while retaining scientific validation.

assumptions: Provisional transfer15 represents actual manual second-system re-entry, not same-system saving or existing import runtime. Midwife performs observation, permitted source extraction, actual study-id/date/measure/unit capture and verification within30. Source system and study owner supply actual field definitions and permitted mapping. Missing data, mismatched definitions or permissions stay manual; no free structured clinical observations or ambient transcript.

Analysis25 retains full completeness, provenance, missingness and scientific checks. Already permitted study scope is a prerequisite, not an invented new approval step for ordinary research saves. Implementation consent/access time is listed separately. No publication send, treatment order or clinical recommendation release is assumed; internal account writing10 remains.
unknowns: Does this study actually re-key verified fields into a distinct dataset?
research_questions: Can study ids, time points and units map without silent eligibility or comparability errors?

incremental.description: Maintain study field definitions, permissions and transfer exception checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes15 actual second-system transfer points minus1.2 upkeep=13.8. Low: heterogeneous historical clinical records need manual extraction and definition reconciliation, leaving only3 already verified compatible field-transfer points removable, minus1.2=1.8. Actual capture, protocol choices, validation, interpretation and written research findings remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
